title: zsh command history
whyItMatters: zsh is the default shell on modern macOS. Its history file can contain typed commands, paths and sometimes tokens or passwords.
source: zsh manual, HISTFILE (macOS default shell since Catalina writes ~/.zsh_history); macforensics.app cheat sheet (Shell History)
notes: Only existence, size and timestamps are recorded. Commands are never read. An extended history file under a custom HISTFILE is out of scope. Reviewed in W3-D2 (independent review, docs/research/macos-review.md).
